title: Diagnose and fix an intermittently failing test
spec:
OBJECTIVE
CI fails roughly one run in four on tests/test_scheduler.py and the team has started re-running the job until it passes. Find the real cause, fix it at the source, and leave the tests meaningful. Do not delete or skip tests, do not add retries, do not widen assertions until they cannot fail.

FILES
src/scheduler.py and tests/test_scheduler.py. Nothing else.

INTERFACES
Scheduler.add(job_id: str, run_at: float) -> None; Scheduler.due(now: float) -> list[str] returns due job ids in a stable, documented order; Scheduler.collect_expired(now: float, ttl: float) -> list[str].
Keep the public interface. You may add an injectable clock.

CONSTRAINTS
The suite must pass 20 of 20 consecutive runs. Both existing test functions must still exist and still assert behaviour. In your final message, name the root cause in one sentence.

VERIFY
for i in $(seq 1 20); do python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q || exit 1; done

REASONING
as invoked
